headline: FULLY FUNDED $9.7M AND ADJACENT TO GALORE CREEK — ORETERRA MOBILIZES TO TREK SOUTH PORPHYRY TARGET IN BC'S GOLDEN TRIANGLE, TWO DRILLS START JULY 16
source_name: Investing News Network / Oreterra Metals Corp.
snippet: Oreterra Metals Corp. announced July 3, 2026 that its geological team has mobilized to establish drill camp at the Trek South porphyry copper-gold prospect in BC's Golden Triangle — a 1.6-kilometre-wide zone of continuous porphyry-style alteration, mineralization, and coincident IP/magnetotelluric/magnetic anomalies recently exposed by glacial ice melt, sitting directly adjacent to the Teck-Newmont Galore Creek deposits. Debt-free and carrying $9.7 million in treasury following a full corporate restructuring and rebrand to Oreterra, the company will commence a maiden two-phase 10,000-metre program with two drill rigs on approximately July 16 — the first diamond drilling ever conducted at Trek South and one of the Golden Triangle's most anticipated maiden tests this summer in a district that already hosts two of the world's largest undeveloped copper-gold porphyry deposits.

headline: 40KM FROM AGNICO'S KITTILÄ GOLD MINE — CAPELLA SPUDS MAIDEN HOLES AT KILLERO W AS AGNICO SURROUNDS ALL FIVE FINLAND PROJECTS AFTER RUPERT ACQUISITION (TSXV:CMIL)
source_name: Investing News Network / Capella Minerals Ltd. (TSXV:CMIL)
snippet: Capella Minerals Ltd. (TSXV:CMIL) announced July 3, 2026 the commencement of the first-ever diamond drill program at the Killero W gold-copper project in Finland's Central Lapland Greenstone Belt — 40 kilometres southwest of Europe's largest gold mine, Agnico Eagle's Kittilä operation — with initial holes targeting two anomalies (PKW-1 and PKW-2) defined by base-of-till gold-copper geochemistry over strongly magnetic host rocks cut by NE-trending structural corridors. Capella's geological position has become strategically compelling since Agnico Eagle completed its acquisition of Rupert Resources on June 16, 2026, effectively surrounding all five of Capella's Northern Finland projects on multiple sides, at a time when operators adjacent to Agnico's new Lapland district are drawing elevated discovery-premium interest from the market.

headline: COMMERCE SECRETARY DELIVERS COPPER REPORT TO TRUMP ON JUNE 30 — COMEX HITS RECORD 650,000 TONNES AS GOLDMAN RAISES TARGET TO $13,735/T, SEES $14,000+ IF TARIFFS BITE
snippet: The U.S. Secretary of Commerce delivered his updated copper market assessment to President Trump on June 30, triggering a new pre-positioning wave that has driven COMEX warehouse inventories to a record 650,000 tonnes — representing 44% of all global exchange copper stocks. Goldman Sachs raised its year-end 2026 LME copper price target to $13,735/t and warned the metal could breach $14,000/t if the anticipated phased refined copper tariffs — 15% starting January 1, 2027, rising to 30% in 2028 — are formally announced, citing a domestic US copper refining capacity gap of over 1 million tonnes that cannot be closed within the tariff phase-in window and will structurally benefit producers in tariff-exempt jurisdictions like Canada, Chile, and Peru while creating a persistent COMEX-LME price premium for domestically produced or qualifying copper.

headline: SPROTT: 'POLICY RISK MEETS PHYSICAL SCARCITY' — THE COMEX-LME COPPER PREMIUM SIGNALS A STRUCTURAL REPRICING, NOT A TEMPORARY DISTORTION
snippet: Sprott Asset Management published an analysis of what it terms the 'emerging copper premium' — the compounding effect of Section 232 tariff uncertainty, record COMEX pre-positioning, and the structural supply deficit driven by the energy transition, EV adoption, and AI data center buildout. The analysis argues that the COMEX-LME arbitrage, which re-widened sharply in early 2026 and reached $400/t by mid-June, is not a temporary disruption but an early signal of a durable premium for domestically produced or tariff-exempt copper that directly benefits US-focused explorers in Idaho, Nevada, and Arizona — whose in-situ copper resources now carry an additional layer of strategic value beyond their geological merit — and creates a powerful re-rating catalyst for the undervalued junior copper sector.

headline: SIGNED BEFORE MIDNIGHT — GOVERNOR SPANBERGER EXTENDS VIRGINIA'S GOLD AND SILVER SALES TAX EXEMPTION TO 2028 AFTER LAST-MINUTE GRASSROOTS CAMPAIGN
snippet: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger signed the state budget on June 30, 2026 — hours before the midnight expiration of the state's existing sales and use tax exemption for gold, silver, and platinum bullion — extending the exemption through June 30, 2028, after the Sound Money Defense League and Money Metals Exchange mobilized thousands of Virginia residents to lobby key legislators. The extension covers qualifying precious metals purchases meeting Virginia's 90%-bullion-content threshold and prevents a lapse that would have immediately subjected in-state bullion buyers to standard sales taxes, representing a clean victory for sound money advocates and a signal that U.S. state-level tax treatment of physical precious metals continues to move in a favourable direction — currently 44 U.S. states exempt bullion purchases from sales tax.

headline: 5.4 g/t AU AND 5.0 g/t AG IN SURFACE GRAB — BULLION GOLD BREAKS GROUND ON VALIDATION DRILLING AT TERRAGOLD, QUEBEC WITH $2M FUNDED (TSXV:BGD)
source_name: Investing News Network / Bullion Gold Resources Corp. (TSXV:BGD)
snippet: Bullion Gold Resources Corp. (TSXV:BGD) reported June 30, 2026 that field preparation at the Terragold Project in Quebec returned surface grab samples of 5.4 g/t gold and 5.0 g/t silver — the silver association being a notable new discovery, as historical records provided little indication of silver potential at the system — and confirmed the commencement of validation diamond drilling designed to follow up historical high-grade intersections at the 100%-owned project. Bullion raised $2 million in a recent private placement to fund the validation program, which will test the continuity, grade, and geometry of Terragold's gold-silver mineralising system at depth; the project is located in Quebec's prolific Abitibi-Témiscamingue metallogenic region, one of the world's most productive gold belts.

headline: 32.8m AT 1.22 g/t AU FROM 166m — GOLD X2 DRILLING INTERSECTS MULTIPLE SHALLOW SHEAR ZONES AT MOSS GOLD PROJECT IN NORTHWEST ONTARIO
snippet: Gold X2 Mining Inc. reported June 30, 2026 that its ongoing infill and resource expansion drilling at the Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario intersected 32.8 metres of 1.22 g/t gold from 166.2 metres depth at the Main Zone — part of a multiple-shear-zone system in the Birch-Uchi Greenstone Belt where several gold-bearing corridors have now been confirmed at shallow to moderate depths amenable to open-pit or bulk-underground extraction. The 2026 drilling results are designed to support an NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate, advancing the project from historical intersection-only status toward a formal resource definition that could support a preliminary economic assessment in northwestern Ontario, a district increasingly attracting junior and mid-tier development capital due to its road access, power infrastructure, and gold endowment.

headline: MARICUNGA GOLD HEAP-LEACH DE-RISKED — TIERNAN GOLD'S PHASE 1 METALLURGICAL RESULTS FROM 36 VOLCAN VARIABILITY SAMPLES ADVANCE CHILE PEA TIMELINE (TSXV:TNGD)
snippet: Tiernan Gold Corp. (TSXV:TNGD) announced July 2, 2026 that Phase 1 diagnostic leach and gold deportment study results from 36 variability samples at the Volcan Gold Project in Chile's Maricunga Gold Belt have returned positive heap-leach amenability indicators, advancing critical metallurgical de-risking ahead of a Preliminary Economic Assessment at one of the Atacama Region's most advanced early-stage gold projects. The Maricunga Belt hosts a cluster of multi-million-ounce gold deposits processed via low-cost heap leach, including the Copiapó, La Pepa, and Salares Norte operations; positive Phase 1 metallurgy confirms Volcan's gold responds to standard industry processing and substantially de-risks the path toward permitting and pre-feasibility work for a potential straightforward heap-leach operation in one of South America's most copper-gold-prolific regions.

headline: BRIEN LUNDIN: MINING STOCKS AT GENERATIONAL DISCOUNT TO GOLD — CENTRAL BANK BULL CREATED THE LAG; PAYROLLS MISS SENDS THE BELATED INVITATION TO EQUITIES
snippet: Gold Newsletter editor Brien Lundin argues in a GoldSeek column that gold and silver mining equities are presenting a value gap not seen since the early 2000s — driven by a bull market propelled by central banks rather than Western retail and institutional flows, which left equities disconnected from rising gold prices for an unusually long period. Lundin contends this lag is historically the best setup for leveraged returns in quality juniors: the early-2000s analogy ultimately saw multi-hundred-percent moves in the equities once retail money followed the central bank price signal, and the June payrolls shock — which collapsed September rate-hike bets below 50% and sent GDX up 4.5% in a day — may represent the inflection point where Western institutional money finally re-enters the equities relative to the metal, with silver historically leading the late-cycle outperformance.

headline: FXEMPIRE: GOLD'S SUMMER PULLBACK IS THE LAST GREAT BUYING WINDOW — $5,000-PLUS RESUMES IN H2 AS FED PIVOT RISK REPLACES HIKE RISK
snippet: FXEmpire's market analysis argues that gold's 26% correction from the January 2026 high of $5,589/oz to the June low below $4,000 constitutes the last meaningful buying window before the metal resumes its structural bull trend toward new all-time highs — with the technical, fundamental, and macro setup now aligning: the 50-week moving average has held as support, central banks are accelerating accumulation on the dip, and the Fed's pivot from hiking to cutting risk eliminates the primary headwind that suppressed institutional re-entry since February. The analysis identifies Q3 2026 as the highest-probability re-entry window for retail investors in physical gold, senior miners, and quality juniors before institutional positioning shifts from underweight to neutral and drives the next leg, with JP Morgan maintaining a year-end gold target above $5,000/oz.
